llm.summary: This documentation-only Go coding-safety skill appears purpose-aligned, with the main notable risk being normal coding-agent access to edit files and run Go/git/linter commands.

dimensions.detail: The visible artifacts consistently focus on defensive Go coding topics such as nil handling, slice/map safety, numeric conversion checks, and resource lifecycle pitfalls.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill grants code-editing and local command tools, which are appropriate for a Go coding/review skill but can affect the user's working tree if used incorrectly.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files; the skill is instruction-only and requires only the Go binary.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Access to Read/Edit/Write plus Go, golangci-lint, and git commands is proportionate for reviewing or fixing Go projects, but users should expect local repository interaction.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

llm.guidance: This skill looks safe for its stated purpose of improving Go code safety. Before installing, be aware that it can help the agent edit files and run Go, golangci-lint, and git commands, so review proposed changes and be especially careful with any git operation that mutates history or publishes code.

evidence.explanation: These disclosed tools allow the agent to inspect and modify project files and run Go, linter, and git commands. That matches the stated Go coding/review purpose, but it is meaningful authority over a local repository.
evidence.snippet: allowed-tools: Read Edit Write Glob Grep Bash(go:*) Bash(golangci-lint:*) Bash(git:*) Agent

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use it on intended Go workspaces, review diffs and command plans, and require explicit approval for git-mutating actions such as commits, resets, pushes, or branch changes.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: When invoked, the agent could change code files and run local project commands; mistakes could alter the working tree or produce unintended git operations.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill exposes disclosed, purpose-aligned coding tools, including file editing and Go/git/linter commands; no hidden execution or deception is evidenced.

permission_boundary.summary: No credential use, account access, or privilege expansion is declared or evidenced.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No persistent memory, broad indexing, external data sharing, or inter-agent data boundary issue is evidenced.
